test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A/An ________ fellow cannot become an ideal teacher.
solution:
The correct answer is: **idle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"idle"** means avoiding work or being lazy; not active or in use. (आलसी)

 
 
• **Example: **He spent an idle afternoon watching TV instead of working.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that an idle man cannot develop into the perfect instructor. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: O
